description: Shared ispf_table_editor pieces: additive ColumnSpec snapshot metadata (cell kind + width) + a pure egui-free snapshot.rs (cell helpers + table builders), and the always-present trailing scratch row in render_ispf_table. Per ispf-table-editor Req 12.1-12.6 / tasks group 12. Shared behaviour every table editor (Menus/Kinds) inherits. Independent of FEAT-001; FEAT-003 depends on it.
steps: TDD: in a sibling tests module for shell/ispf_table_editor/state.rs write FAILING tests for ColumnSpec snapshot metadata: default cell kind is Text with the header width; with_snapshot(kind, width) sets both; ColumnSpec stays Copy.

TDD: write FAILING pure unit tests (in the new snapshot module's #[cfg(test)]) for combo_cell/text_cell/sanitise_cell: combo_cell(value,width) -> [value v], empty combo -> [ v], padded to width; text_cell(value,width) -> value padded to width, or a run of _ filling width when empty; a value longer than width is NOT truncated (it widens); sanitise_cell replaces tab/CR/LF with a space; the helper signatures have NO hint-text parameter.

TDD: write FAILING tests for snapshot_table(columns, rows, scratch_cells) -> ff_screen_model::Table (headers from column headers; one table row per host row with each column's cell kind + width applied; then the scratch row) and raw_table(columns, rows) -> Table (RAW unpadded values, no scratch).

Implement: add `cell: CellKind` and `snapshot_width: usize` fields + a new `pub enum CellKind { Text, Combo }` (default Text) + a const builder `with_snapshot(self, kind, width)` to ColumnSpec in crates/ff-desktop/src/shell/ispf_table_editor/state.rs; default cell = Text, default width = header width; keep ColumnSpec Copy.

Implement: create crates/ff-desktop/src/shell/ispf_table_editor/snapshot.rs (pure, egui-free) with combo_cell/text_cell/sanitise_cell/snapshot_table/raw_table; register the module in shell/ispf_table_editor/mod.rs. Make the FEAT-002 tests pass.

TDD: write a FAILING full-shell egui_kittest test (model it on the Alias host over the shared surface, or a minimal test host) that a NON-EMPTY list shows a trailing scratch row after the last displayed data row; typing in it promotes it to a real backing row and a fresh scratch row appears; an untouched scratch row is never persisted; the first-Tab target is UNCHANGED (still the filter row's first control).

Implement the always-present trailing scratch row in crates/ff-desktop/src/shell/ispf_table_editor/render.rs::render_ispf_table: after rendering the displayed data rows, ALWAYS render one empty insertable scratch row built from blank_scratch() (today it renders only when rows.is_empty()); promote-on-edit identically to the empty-list branch; push its cell ids LAST into field_matrix so it is the last focus stop; do NOT change anchors.first. Keep the empty-list behaviour identical.

Confirm by inspection (no code) that no new crate, persistence format, ff-line-commands change, or WorkspaceContext/InteriorFocus change was introduced; the ColumnSpec addition is an ff-desktop-internal struct field.
acceptance_criteria: ColumnSpec carries cell kind + snapshot width with a Copy const with_snapshot builder; default is Text at header width.

snapshot.rs provides pure combo_cell/text_cell/sanitise_cell with the exact conventions ([value v], [ v], ____ fill, widen-not-truncate, control-char->space, no hint param) and snapshot_table/raw_table builders.

render_ispf_table renders an always-present trailing scratch row for non-empty lists that promotes on edit, is the last focus stop, does not change first_interior_id, and is never persisted untouched -- covered by the egui_kittest test.

`cargo test -p ff-desktop ispf_table_editor` scoped names pass; `cargo clippy -p ff-desktop -- -D warnings` and `cargo fmt -p ff-desktop -- --check` clean; every touched .rs under 400 non-test lines (snapshot.rs is a new small module).
verification: cargo check -p ff-desktop  (redirect to a unique _ignore/logs/ log; read it back)
cargo test -p ff-desktop ispf_table_editor::snapshot  (and the ColumnSpec + scratch-row test names)
findings: Implemented in crates/ff-desktop (worktree alias-kind-impl). (1) state.rs: added `pub enum CellKind { Text, Combo }` (Default=Text, derives Copy) and two additive ColumnSpec fields `cell: CellKind` + `snapshot_width: usize`; default cell=Text, default snapshot_width=header.len() (ASCII headers, so byte==char count). Added const builder `with_snapshot(self, kind, width)`; ColumnSpec stays Copy. (2) NEW snapshot.rs (pure, egui-free, 145 non-test lines, has #![allow(dead_code)] until FEAT-003 consumes it): sanitise_cell (tab/CR/LF -> space), combo_cell(value,width) -> `[value v]` / `[ v]` padded, text_cell(value,width) -> value padded or `_`*width when empty, both widen-not-truncate, NO hint param; snapshot_table(columns, rows, scratch_cells) -> ff_screen_model::Table (headers + cell-rendered rows + trailing scratch row); raw_table(columns, rows) -> Table (raw unpadded, no scratch). Registered in mod.rs and re-exported (CellKind + snapshot fns, behind #[allow(unused_imports)]). (3) render.rs::render_ispf_table: now ALWAYS renders one trailing scratch row (from blank_scratch()) after the displayed data rows at backing index rows.len(); promotes on edit (scratch != default -> push); cell ids pushed LAST into field_matrix (last focus stop); anchors.first unchanged (filter row stays first_interior_id); empty-list behaviour identical (index 0). Added a #[cfg(test)] egui_kittest module (TestHost impl IspfTableHost+IspfTableRender; inject_at simulates an edit through the real surface path) covering: non-empty list trailing scratch promotes on edit, untouched scratch never persisted, first_interior_id unchanged, empty-list unchanged. NOTES for later steps: ColumnSpec default snapshot_width = header.len(); combo_cell yields 9 chars for a 5-char value (`[FFCMD v]`), so a column's snapshot_width should account for the `[ v]` wrapper (+4) + the longest combo value; snapshot_table appends the scratch row via row_cells(columns, scratch_cells) so the host passes snapshot_cells(&blank_row()) as scratch_cells (Req 12.3). FEAT-003 (Alias host wiring: ALIAS_COLUMNS with_snapshot metadata + alias_snapshot_cells + table/markdown builders) consumes snapshot::{snapshot_table, raw_table, combo_cell, text_cell} and the #![allow(dead_code)] can be removed then. Verification (compile-only, scoped, logs under _ignore/logs/): cargo check -p ff-desktop CLEAN; cargo clippy -p ff-desktop --all-targets -- -D warnings CLEAN; cargo fmt -p ff-desktop -- --check CLEAN; cargo test -p ff-desktop --bin ffwb ispf_table_editor = 57 passed / 0 failed (includes the new ColumnSpec, snapshot, and render scratch-row tests). All touched .rs under 400 non-test lines (state 313, render 270, snapshot 145). No new crate, no persistence format, no ff-line-commands change, no WorkspaceContext/InteriorFocus change, no Cargo.toml change -- ColumnSpec additions are ff-desktop-internal struct fields (Req 12.8).
